primary_comparison.kind: electronic transcription, not an inspection of the 1784 facsimile
primary_comparison.observed_difference: The Korpora transcription has 'außer dem da'; the pinned source has 'außer dem daß'. The pinned source is preserved.

decisions: halte is read as attributing the dangerousness judgment to the people, not as asserting actual high danger
the burdensomeness parenthesis is provisionally represented as author-level background content; scope remains reviewable
the autonomy-directed activity need not have been performed or completed
by far the largest share retains both a strict-majority condition and a separate contextual degree criterion
no fixed numeric danger probability, damage amount or very-dangerous threshold is supplied
unrepresented: the parenthetical inclusion of the female group
the guardians bringing about this judgment and their assumption of supervision
the additive focus and ironic evaluation
the ensuing livestock and walking-frame comparisons
alternative_readings: The burden assessment may also be included in the people's own judgments. The current source fragment does not claim to settle this scope.
An autonomy-directed activity is only a partial account of the metaphorical step toward maturity.
